name: dialog_use_hold
about: +use on an NPC holds it in a dialogue program, then releases it. CBasePlayer::PlayerUse 0x10167850 resolves the use target (0x10167470 -> FindEntityFOV 0x10341c30), asks the NPC's slot 295 CanTalk(player) 0x102c21c0 (false: return, no ordinary use), resets its think timers (slot 614), installs SCHED_TROIKA_RUN_DIALOG 0x6a through 0x102ae750(npc, 0x6a, 0) -> ForceScheduleChange 0x102ae490 (no ClearSchedule; TASK_RUN_DIALOG 0; interrupt COND_PROVOKED) and calls player slot 414 FUN_10178280, the real StartDialog, whose CDialog::Acquire 0x100e05f0 runs the NPC's StartTalking 0x102c0270 (sets the NPC's m_hDialogPartner +0xfe8, fires OnDialogBegin) (packets.md R1/R2; game_runtime.md § Retail conversation chain, item 1). TASK_RUN_DIALOG 0xb9 (start 0x102a496b, run 0x102ab303) holds while IsInDialog 0x102c1170 stands. A dialogue writes no m_NPCState: the NPC stays Idle throughout. The release: the player's pick -1 -> CDialog::Release 0x100e5240 -> the NPC's 0x102c0360 fires m_OnDialogEnd +0x5f5c once and clears the partner; the run arm completes the task, the program ends and SelectSchedule picks again. sp_tutorial_1's Hunter1 (npc_VHumanCombatant, dialogname dlg/generic/hunter1.dlg, D_LI 0, use_interesting 0, one OnDialogEnd wire) verbatim on the north pad; the player ~95 cm south of it, facing it, inside PlayerUse's 80-unit reach.
known_red: V3d: +use pushes no SCHED_TROIKA_RUN_DIALOG program (the port opens a +use conversation synchronously through its dialogue body session, M12). Triaged 2026-10-04 (bug protocol step 1): game red in the port's use focus, not the record or the harness -- the +use edge reaches FElysiumEntityWorld::UpdatePlayerInteraction (verbs_stealth_kill's OnGrappleBegin 17 ms after the same console press), but no FElysiumNpcDialogue::Begin runs (no 'OnDialogBegin -> none' output, no 'opened dialogue' log); AElysiumMapActor::QueryPlayerUse accepts only a registered use-anchor proxy and counts Hunter1's own Pawn capsule (which blocks ElysiumUse, the visual and its proxy hang below it) as an occluder, where retail's FindEntityFOV 0x10341c30 hit IS the NPC. Fix placed in V3d (triage row)
notes: Packet R2 settled PlayerUse's NPC arm: CanTalk, slot 614, 0x102ae750(npc, 0x6a, 0), slot 414; no ClearSchedule 0x10280d30. Packet R1 settled the once-only OnDialogEnd (0x102c0360 fires only for a live partner and clears it; CDialog::Release 0x100e5240 is the one door) and the output -> taskdone order: the program completes on the first TASK_RUN_DIALOG tick after the release on which IsInDialog's four terms are clear. Staging checked against retail 2026-10-04: Hunter1 (vmf: dialogname dlg/generic/hunter1.dlg, player_reaction D_LI 0, OnDialogEnd -> hunterQuests()) passes CanTalk; the player's eye (64 u) is 37 u from its origin, facing it, inside the 80 u use reach. `dialog_choose end` is retail's pick -1 through the port's Continue door (H12).
